text:
alex: Heads-up — after the workspace-import job v2 ran at 03:12 UTC we might have a cross-org exposure. Project metadata from org-alpha is showing up under org-beta. :eyes:

maria: Ugh. Seen the same. Can you paste the audit lines you found?

sam: quick grep from the audit store:
```
2026-03-20T03:12:18Z INFO workspace.import job_id=wj-9123 status=done src_org=org-alpha dst_cluster=cluster-us-east mapping=workspaces_v2
2026-03-20T03:12:19Z WARN auth.check svcacc=svc-importer@redwood action=grant role=workspace.viewer target_org=org-beta src_org=org-alpha request_id=rid-44af
```

jorge: That WARN is the issue — the role-mapping table migration added a fallback path that treats missing workspace.owner bindings as org-wide viewer. New RBAC refactor PR (rbr/role-refactor) changed the lookup order. I flagged it in code review but apparently not in migration.

alex: Is this a read-only leak or can tokens in org-alpha perform writes in org-beta?

sam: Initial checks look like reads only (list, get). No create/delete observed yet. However the svc-importer used a long-lived svcacc token with KMS-derived credentials. We should rotate that key as a precaution.

maria: Agreed. Immediate mitigation: 1) disable workspace-import job v2, 2) revoke svc-importer token, 3) patch permission-sanitizer to force strict org boundary checks.

ops-oncall: Disabled job v2 at 03:18 UTC. Notifying customers with any workspace transfers in the last 48h.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0319-18. Priority: P1. Owners: eng-security, eng-platform. Checklist assigned.

jorge: Patch is small, here is the fix to the lookup order (pseudo):
```
- role = lookupRole(workspace, user)
- if role == null:
-    role = lookupOrgRole(user, workspace.org)
+ role = lookupRole(workspace, user)
+ if role == null:
+    // enforce workspace org match before falling back
+    if user.org == workspace.org:
+        role = lookupOrgRole(user, workspace.org)
+    else:
+        role = null
```

maria: I'll open a hotfix branch and run unit + integration tests against a snapshot of the importer state. Sam — can you export the relevant audit slice to `s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0319-18/audit-slice.jsonl`? Include the auth.check lines and any KMS decrypt calls.

sam: Uploading now. Also found KMS logs referencing key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333:key/abc-123 while importer ran. We should check key policy and whether cross-account/grant was used.

alex: Forensics ask: preserve the svcacc token usage, KMS decrypt timeline, and full workspace import payloads. Set retention to immutable for 30d for this incident bucket.

ops-oncall: Done: bucket policies set, retention + immutability enabled at 03:27 UTC.

security-bot: Note: we may need to rotate KMS key if there is any evidence of key grant misuse. Recommend KMS rotation and re-encrypting importer secrets with a new key.

maria: Hotfix PR opened: eng-platform#2891. Patch includes the lookup change + extra unit tests validating cross-org scenarios. I'm running canary in staging.

jorge: Also adding an audit alert rule: if auth.check grants a role where src_org != target_org and action in (list,get), fire high-sev alert.

alex: Good. After staging validation we should do a controlled rollback of any object state that may have been duplicated across orgs and alert affected org admins. Maria — add a template for customer comms. Keep language minimal and factual.

maria: Will draft. Also coordinating with legal/compliance for scope of notification.

sam: One more note — importer was using a migration flag `--legacy-role-fallback` enabled by default in v2. Turning that off should be part of the rollback path.

ops-oncall: Confirmed flag turned off in config store at 03:36 UTC.

alex: Next steps (owners): maria apply hotfix + staged rollout (eng-platform), sam finish audit export + key policy review (eng-security infra), jorge add alert + testcases (eng-ml/infra). We reconvene in 30m.

security-bot: Meeting scheduled: incident-call in #incidents at 04:00 UTC.

alex: Thanks everyone. Keep thread updated with one-line status changes. :lock:
